messages.content: What is the dominant genetic trait of a Lion?

function.name: genetics_get_variant_frequency

message.content: In domestic cats, the presence of a mane (or “mane”‑like hair growth) is controlled by a dominant allele. In lions, the same gene that controls mane development in domestic cats is also present and is expressed as a dominant trait in male lions. This means that if a lion inherits the allele from either parent, it will develop a mane.
